lede: The most concrete government action this week is the San Miguel County Planning Commission taking up three Land Use Code amendments — covering forestry practices, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — on September 10th, with their recommendations heading to the BOCC if approved. Most other meetings either haven't posted agendas yet or have been rescheduled, including the Telluride Town Council budget session now pushed to October 13th. On the community side, the Telluride Film Festival carries the week.

notable.stake: County Land Use Code changes on forestry, oil/gas, and geothermal head to BOCC next.
